title: Norvane C24 homeowner user guide

controls.summary: The control panel is behind the drop-down flap on the front of the boiler.

items.description: Shows the heating flow temperature when running, the system pressure when idle, and a fault code beginning with F if something needs attention.
Sets the temperature of the water sent to your radiators, from 30 °C to 80 °C. Around 60 °C to 65 °C suits most homes and keeps the boiler condensing efficiently.
Sets the hot water temperature at the tap, from 40 °C to 60 °C. We suggest 50 °C.
Cycles between Winter (heating and hot water), Summer (hot water only) and Standby (frost protection only).
Press and hold for 3 seconds to restart the boiler after a lockout.

toppingUpPressure.normalRange: 1.0 to 1.5 bar when the heating is cold
steps: Switch the heating off and let the system cool for at least an hour.
Read the pressure on the display. If it is below 1.0 bar, the system needs topping up.
Find the grey filling lever underneath the boiler, on the left-hand side.
Pull the lever down slowly. You will hear water entering the system.
Watch the display and release the lever when the pressure reaches 1.3 bar. Do not go above 1.5 bar.
Check the lever has sprung back fully, then switch the heating on again.
toppingUpPressure.warning: If you need to top up more than twice a year, or the pressure climbs above 2.5 bar when the heating is hot, ask a registered engineer to check the system.

steps: Note the fault code on the display before you do anything.
Press and hold the Reset button for 3 seconds, then release.
Wait up to 2 minutes while the boiler runs its start-up checks.
reset.limit: You can reset up to 3 times in any 15 minutes. If the fault returns, stop and call a registered engineer. Repeated resets will not fix the cause.
reset.warning: If you smell gas, do not reset the boiler. Leave the property and call the National Gas Emergency Service on 0800 111 999.

frostProtection.summary: Frost protection works in every mode, including Standby, as long as the gas and electricity are on.
details: If the water inside the boiler drops below 5 °C, the pump and burner run until it reaches 15 °C.
This protects the boiler itself, not the whole house. Leave the room thermostat at 12 °C or higher if you are away in winter.
The condensate pipe can freeze in very cold weather. If it does, the display shows F25. See the fault code page for the safe way to thaw it.

annualService.summary: Your 10-year warranty depends on a service by a registered engineer every 12 months. The spanner symbol on the display lights up 11 months after the last service as a reminder.
whatToExpect: The engineer checks combustion, safety devices, the flue and the condensate trap, and records the visit in your service log.
Keep the service log safe. You will need it if you ever make a warranty claim.

dailyUseTips: Bleed radiators once a year, before the heating season.
Keep the area around the boiler clear and never block air vents or the flue terminal outside.
A lower heating dial setting with longer running times is usually cheaper than short bursts at high temperature.

toppingUpPressure.normalRange: Not applicable. The R18 works on an open-vented system.

If the system keeps needing to be bled, ask a registered engineer to check the feed tank and ball valve.
toppingUpPressure.warning: Do not fit a filling loop to this boiler. It is not designed for a sealed system unless an engineer has installed the sealed system kit.
